auth_test.description: Read-only identity check. Slack documents POST auth.test; ok must be true.

search_messages.description: Keyword search over messages the authed token can see, bounded by that token's own visibility. Requires a user token with search:read; bot tokens cannot search. Read-only, safe to poll.

query.description: Slack search syntax, e.g. "deploy failed" in:#ops after:2026-10-01.

post_message.description: Sends a message to a channel.

conversations_history.description: Fetch message history for a channel (read-only; cursor pagination via response_metadata.next_cursor, incremental sync via oldest).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's response_metadata.next_cursor.

oldest.description: Only messages after this Unix timestamp (watermark for incremental sync).

conversations_replies.description: Fetch a thread of messages anchored at a parent message ts (read-only; cursor-paginated).

ts.description: Timestamp of the thread's parent message.

files_list.description: List files visible to the authed token, optionally scoped to a channel (read-only; page-numbered pagination).
